theorem_contract.regularity: For a certified cell and fixed direction d, orient d so that D_d f > 0 over the whole cell.
theorem_contract.line_uniqueness: Strict positivity of D_d f implies at most one zero on every chord parallel to d inside the convex cell.
theorem_contract.center_chord_crossing: If conservative endpoint bounds on the center chord prove f(entry)<0 and f(exit)>0, continuity plus strict monotonicity proves exactly one zero on that chord.
theorem_contract.full_oriented_crossing: If every inflow boundary face has f<0 and every outflow boundary face has f>0, every nondegenerate chord parallel to d that intersects the box has exactly one zero.
theorem_contract.c0_existence_bridge: If C0 already proved zero existence and C1 proved directional regularity, the cell has at least one zero and at most one zero per d-parallel chord, even when full boundary crossing is not proved.
